stem.text: Carbon monoxide burns readily in oxygen to form carbon dioxide.

items: The +4 oxidation state of carbon is more stable than the +2 state.
The standard enthalpy change of formation of carbon dioxide is more negative than the standard enthalpy change of formation of carbon monoxide.
The value of the equilibrium constant for the reaction, $2\text{CO(g)} + \text{O}_2\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons 2\text{CO}_2\text{(g)}$, is likely to be high.
